dispatch_policy: Single logical wave, global observed capacity<=2. One other project runner present; backlog submitted into one free slot, protocol pending until capacity. Do not cancel others or create another wave.

cost_basis: Client estimate is not Coding Plan charge; no cash charge inferred.
